arguments.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY the TWO ROUND OUTBOARD WING-ENGINE REAR ENDS in this rear-oriented mecha image. They currently resemble forward-facing intake fans, which is mechanically wrong for this view. The engine bodies and their mounting, size, position and axis stay exactly fixed. Replace the visible circular interior on BOTH engines with unmistakable REAR JET EXHAUST: a dark recessed hollow nozzle, graphite segmented exhaust lip/petals and a deep dark inner opening, with no central hub, NO FAN BLADES and no turbine-intake disk. The nearest left engine and farther right engine must both be rear exhausts. No glow or flame. Do not change the two stacked rectangular grilles in the center backpack; they are already correct. Preserve every other pixel-layout feature: same head/mane, wings and two vertical fins, torso/backpack, massive fists, arms, train shells, hips, knees, calves, treads, heels, pose, camera, framing, line style and colors. Only the two outboard circular engine rear-end interiors/rims are repaired, not the whole image. Same ivory background, no labels.
